post.description: Returns only supported matches (zero to maxResults, default ceiling 10), a shared assessment and overview, optional grounded related searches, plan dependencies, question, or no-match reason. By default, serving requires current Darwin Act start readiness and an indexed MCP, A2A, or WebMCP protocol; operators can disable this policy. Each match includes nullable execution metadata and typed connection methods. Null provider endpoints are not verified direct connections. Exact identities skip the model relevance gate but not the serving policy. Continue with previousResponseId. Public supply only; no private scope or execution.

503.description: Search or a required dependency unavailable

200.description: Ordered, paginated responses in this search

post.description: Pilot preview: new starts and continuations require an exact credential ID in the Act pilot allowlist; other callers receive ACT_PREVIEW_ACCESS_REQUIRED (403). Exactly one of searchId, targets, or threadId. For a Search handoff, arguments is an object keyed by agentId (not capabilityId); each value is that agent’s capability arguments. Omit arguments to open a text-only thread, not execute a tool. Search handoff requires the same owner credential; an anonymous Search also requires X-Search-Token. Caller identity comes from the credential. A user API key requires agent:write; OAuth requires a live human:actions grant. Authentication and payment messages open hosted consent or selection for a request in that exact thread; they do not submit secrets or charge a payment.

200.description: An Act Request with one or more thread receipts, or a typed thread continuation receipt.

400.description: Invalid request or stale Search handoff

403.description: Act pilot access required, or agent or thread access denied

parameters.name: includeThreadState
parameters.description: Include authorized child thread messages, actions and pending requests.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: Read state for this child thread only. Must belong to the Act request.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Read the next message page for threadId. Requires includeThreadState=true.

200.description: Act request receipt and optional live, authorized child thread state.

forkSearchId.description: Copy a public Search conversation into a new owned search before refining it.

arguments.description: Capability arguments keyed by agentId from the selected Search result. Omit for a text-only thread; capabilityId keys are invalid.

status.description: Act Request handoff status only. Completed means thread receipts were created; read each thread for action confirmation and provider result.

errors.description: Error events in this page. Retryable does not authorize replaying an accepted effect or payment.
